issues.issue: Did the officer refuse reconsideration at the first stage, or reconsider the H&C decision on the merits without adequate reasons?
issues.applicant_position: Officer actually reconsidered on the merits, assessing new evidence superficially without adequate justification.
issues.respondent_position: Officer refused at the first stage only; reviewed the new evidence and explained the refusal, which is all the law requires.
issues.result_quote: There is little question that, as a second stage decision, the Reconsideration Decision is not reasonable.

issues.issue: Was it unreasonable to refuse reconsideration only because the new evidence could have been submitted earlier?
issues.applicant_position: Refusal rested solely on timing; the officer had to address other IRCC reconsideration factors.
issues.result_quote: An officer is not required to refer to factors in the IRCC guidelines that are not relevant to the reconsideration request under review.
